flags.reason: misreads-source: Fact /facts/props/15 says modes cascade to the card's own children: rows, icons, figures, button and upsell. Only the `bodyHeader` declaration (/facts/props/6) says "`modes` cascade into the slot", so the claim about header and children slot nodes is unsupported.

notes: /facts/gaps/2 adds "including Color Mode Dark". This follows logically from the evidence's "No mode changes the card's surface or title" and the guide's "stay white and black in every mode". However, the evidence's Limits say Dark is not shown, so a human may want to confirm that Dark was actually checked rather than inferred. /anatomy/4 marks the Benefit row alwaysPresent=true.
